task: Bound the GitHub Copilot CLI and BaseAgentAdapter version probes in codemie-code with a 5s limit, treating a timeout as unknown version and releasing the abandoned child process so the CLI exits promptly.

key_reasoning.reason: Three components in one repo: CopilotCliPlugin.getVersion, BaseAgentAdapter.getVersion and, because AC6 requires releasing an unresponsive child (exec() today only sends one SIGTERM, never closes stdio or escalates), the shared exec() utility in utils/exec.ts. Base would be M; bumped to L because a core shared utility is touched. If codex/gemini/claude/kimi probes come into scope (they override getVersion and do not call super), this rises to XL (4+ components, 5 plugins) and the total rises to roughly 21-24 (L).

Closest pattern is the inline { timeout: 5000 } on frameworks and native-installer probes, but it only rejects the promise. It does not cover AC6 (child ignores SIGTERM and holds pipes open, so the event loop stays alive): this needs SIGKILL escalation, stdio destroy or unref, with Windows (shell:false, windowsHide) behaviour unverified. That is a divergence from the pattern. AC6 also lists a specific error/edge case, and there is no existing exec() test template for timeout or hung-child cases (no exec test file found), so Technical Risk is bumped. exec() changes also affect all callers, including interactive ones and 300000 ms ones.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from M to L: touches core shared utility exec() (needed for AC6 process release)
Technical Risk set to L: closest pattern (inline timeout) does not cover process release; AC6 enumerates an edge case with no existing test template
